settings.heading: Check the policy
settings.text: Confirm timing, condition requirements, fees, and exclusions.

settings.heading: Send a request
settings.text: Share your order number, item, reason, and preferred resolution.

settings.heading: Wait for review
settings.text: The team will confirm eligibility and send the correct next steps.

settings.heading: Pack and return
settings.text: Follow the provided instructions and keep your shipping record.

settings.heading: Keep the packaging
settings.text: Keep the item and original packaging until the request is reviewed.

settings.heading: Do not send it yet
settings.text: Wait for return instructions and the correct destination before shipping.

settings.heading: Damage needs detail
settings.text: For transit damage, keep all packaging. The team may request clear photos.

settings.question: Should I ship the item now?
settings.answer: No. Submit a request and wait for instructions so your return reaches the correct location with the right reference.

settings.question: Does submitting the form approve my return?
settings.answer: No. It starts a review. Approval depends on the order, item condition, timing, and the published return policy.

settings.question: What if the item arrived damaged?
settings.answer: Keep the product and all packaging. Describe the issue in the form; the team will explain how to share photos and what happens next.
